name: k14-office-dashboard
prompt: Make one new photograph, not a reference sheet: the person from the reference sheet appears once, with exactly the same face, hair and clothes, in a real place. A medium shot in the Pune office at golden hour: the woman in the navy pinstripe kurta with the lanyard sits beside a slim Indian man in his mid-thirties in a charcoal polo shirt, both looking at a large monitor that shows a pale green dashboard with a rising line chart, stacked bars and a few cards, no readable words; she points at the chart with a pen, he nods, warm low light from the window across the desk. Photorealistic documentary photograph, 35 mm lens, natural light, realistic skin and fabric. No text, no logos, no lettering, no signs anywhere; every pack and carton unbranded.
